openwrtfi-admin.description: Write ubus access for OpenWrtFi's action handlers, granted to the logged-in dashboard admin's own rpcd session (docs/api.md's Auth section: writes run under *that user's* session, never a service account). Install as /usr/share/rpcd/acl.d/openwrtfi-admin.json on every node (gateway and APs) and assign it to whichever user logs into the dashboard. The root LuCI user already has unrestricted rpcd access and doesn't need this; it matters for a dedicated non-root admin account.
